personas/docs/agents/project-manifest/constraints.md: The new constraints (44, 45) are correctly numbered and placed per the plan. However, a pre-existing file structure quirk creates a non-sequential reading order: a reader scanning top-to-bottom encounters 35 → 44 → 45 → (section break) → 36 → 37 → 39 → 40 → 41 → 42 → 43. This is not introduced by this PR — constraints 36-43 existed in the 'Intentional Differences' and 'Pre-Commit Guard' sections before this work. Additionally, constraint #38 is missing from the Intentional Differences sequence (36, 37, skip, 39). Consider a future housekeeping pass to renumber constraints into a single monotonic sequence or add section-local numbering prefixes.
